gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Angular and a bit futuristic, Megrim holds even its g to one unchanging line weight. Noto Sans Gujarati supplies the opposite quality: wide-open counters and curves that end before they turn inward.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Sharp and futuristic, Megrim keeps its curves at full weight through every turn. And Noto Sans Gurmukhi, with tong-like outward terminals, lends a steadier, more grounded voice below.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-imperial-aramaic: Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic spreads its c ends apart like pincers, with lowercase a short step below the capitals. But beneath Megrim, with its contrast-free angles, running text feels approachable and easy to settle into.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-inscriptional-pa: Futuristic Megrim ends every stroke as wide as its middle, while Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian brings big open eyes. Sharp precision up top, a deep and generous middle band below.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Flat, single-weight linework defines angular Megrim, every stroke ending at a measured thickness with a skyward x-height line. Noto Sans Kaithi fills the line with open-channeled, capital-like lowercase forms.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Not a single stroke thins out in Megrim, whose connecting strokes match its stems in angular, futuristic fashion. Megrim draws attention; Noto Sans Lydian quietly keeps capitals low and openings wide.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Angular cut-ribbon strokes make Megrim feel futuristic, every line a constant width. Noto Sans Mahajani is the more modern voice, its lowercase standing tall against the capitals, e throats wide like funnels.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Sharp, futuristic Megrim skims along on one unchanging stroke weight, while its sans partner curls loose and unclamped. Give Megrim the big sizes and Noto Sans Mandaic the smaller text.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-mende-kikakui: Noto Sans Mende Kikakui shows daylight through every curved opening. Megrim above it is angular and futuristic, with an o like a ring of constant wall, and the two share crisp, modern clarity.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Futuristic and angular, Megrim holds the steady line of a technical drafting pen. Noto Sans Meroitic does the quieter work, offering see-through c openings and lowercase forms that fill the line like capitals.
